purpose: Cross-cluster validation of TFLOPS measurements at 304 CUs

hsa_cu_mask_nonfunctionality.test: TFLOPS ratio 152CU/304CU (should be ~0.555 if mask works)
hsa_cu_mask_nonfunctionality.verdict: HSA_CU_MASK non-functional on MI300X gfx942 (ROCm 7.0.2 and 7.2.0)
hsa_cu_mask_nonfunctionality.amd_documentation_note: AMD ROCm 6.2+ release notes document HSA_CU_MASK deprecation for gfx942 (MI300X). The environment variable was designed for gfx908/gfx90a. On CDNA3, wavefront scheduling ignores CU mask bits.

concurrent_bw_classification_safety.context: Iris BW under concurrent GEMM not yet measured (script k020_cycle3_iris_bw_under_gemm.py ready but blocked by ROCm 7.x WS kernel incompatibility)
concurrent_bw_classification_safety.safety_bound: BW degradation is classification-SAFE: lower concurrent BW increases comm time, which INCREASES alpha_BE (makes coexec look better). For Lg16K MONITOR to flip to NO-GO, BW would need to INCREASE by >4x to 840 GB/s — physically impossible on MI300X HBM3 (5.3 TB/s peak shared across all CUs).
concurrent_bw_classification_safety.verdict: Classification-safe regardless of concurrent BW measurement

overall_summary.verdict: ALL PASS — measurements are reproducible across clusters, ROCm versions, and sample counts
